title: Saturday compost drop-off notice
passage:
Brook Hollow Community Garden | Saturday drop-off
Drop household fruit and vegetable scraps at the garden shed between 9 and 11. Please empty your scraps into the marked tub and take your container home. The volunteers cannot accept meat, fish or packaging, including bags sold as compostable.
If the shed is closed because of heavy rain, check the chalkboard by the gate. When it reads “Indoor drop-off”, bring your scraps to the market hall during the same hours. When it reads “Cancelled”, take everything home. Neither sign changes what the volunteers accept.
Finished compost becomes available on the first Saturday of each month. Bring a separate bucket to collect it. In the market hall, volunteers can take incoming scraps but cannot give out finished compost. If scrap drop-off moves indoors on a compost collection day, the finished-compost collection is postponed; collect your share at the shed the following Saturday.
passageZh:
溪谷社區菜園｜星期六回收
上午九點至十一點，可將家中的蔬果廚餘拿到菜園小屋。請將廚餘倒入有標示的桶中，再把自己的容器帶回家。志工不收肉、魚或包裝，包括標榜可堆肥的袋子。
如果大雨導致小屋關閉，請查看大門旁的黑板。寫著「改到室內回收」時，請在同一時段將廚餘送到市場大廳。若寫著「取消」，就把所有東西帶回家。兩種公告都不會改變志工接受哪些物品。
每月第一個星期六可以領取成品堆肥，請另帶一個桶子。市場大廳的志工可收進站的廚餘，但不能發放成品堆肥。若領取堆肥當天的廚餘回收改到室內，成品堆肥就延後發放；請在下一個星期六到菜園小屋領取自己那一份。
